_comment: Tioga / AMD MI250X / HPE Slingshot CXI / libfabric OFI. v1 hand-written from M1 data; to be replaced by rule-list fitter output after M3 R022 calibration completes. NIC caps pinned to HPDC26/content/problem.tex Table 1.

rules._why: Regular stencil (Jacobi) with a topology hint — use triggered path with deeper slot pipeline to overlap host retire with next-barrier arm. M1 R014 at N=32 showed 1.49x (not 2x) over N=16 indicating comm saturation; deeper stage-ahead should help.

Compute-heavy pattern (matmul) with constant peer ring — proxy path with a larger source-buffer pool. M1 R016/R017 showed matmul regressing N=16→32 (3326→3927 ms); the proxy path's per-hop pipelining beats the triggered path when comm dominates.
Catch-all conservative variant. Minimum-feasible proxy path, always within CXI caps even at N=4096.
